outcome: Let the research assistant discover all authorized Experiments by default
owner_impact: A Professor-connected research assistant now discovers student/researcher Experiments that are already visible through Professor supervision without requiring a copy first or a hidden ownership flag. The assistant can read and discuss that supervised work directly; `owned_only=true` remains available when the conversation specifically needs only the Professor's own Experiments. Existing RLS still determines what each account is allowed to see.

next.text: The approved two-front sequence continues with #299 — restructure Experiment navigation and Professor supervision UX under living UI/UX epic #273. That ticket will move supervision out of Account and rethink own/shared/supervised Experiment navigation as one coherent UI/UX pass. It has not started yet.

technical_evidence: read_workspace now defaults owned_only=false and documents all-RLS-visible discovery explicitly.
owned_only=true still applies the owner_id filter, so callers can deliberately narrow discovery without changing authorization.
MCP server patch version 3.0.1 preserves interface version 8 and all write tools remain owner-scoped.
